goal: 以真实 stdio MCP SDK 协议替换虚构工具成功的占位提供端
acceptance: Pinned SDK and actual Python process observations preserve initialization, negotiation, list/call/error/notification fields, concurrent correlation, environment scrub, malformed/closed/cancelled failures and owned termination; negative observer mutations cannot pass.
Actual ToolsService consumers execute the advertised tools and cannot observe fabricated success; startup/dispose races and rollback are exercised together with provider ownership.
Full Python 3.8 and a clean receipt-bound actual extracted Portable run pass before bounded integration; no HTTP/SSE/supervisor/ACP/subagent certification is inferred.
open_findings: First implementation portion: actual stdio provider, owned late-spawn/close/cancel/EOF, source-based supervisor and ToolsService activation plus full Portable gate wiring. Development preview passed 5172 tests, 6 skipped, one existing warning, 28 mandatory lanes, 722 untouched source assertions, 29 paired drivers and actual extracted MCP consumer/process ownership. Eleven exact raw source/native process rows match. Preview is dirty and publishable=false; no bounded integration is issued. Prior preview and concurrent browser startup cancellations remain un-attributed and preserved; later passing runs are not a fix. SDK schema/config/tool projection corrections are isolated follow-up work (959 raw schema rows, 176 config rows, twenty process pairs, 278 targeted tests); not current main candidate acceptance. Full paired supervisor/rich Tools, HTTP/SSE, ACP mounting/subagent and clean acceptance remain pending.
next_action: 提交已通过完整预览的 stdio/lifecycle 第一部分；合入隔离工作树的固定 SDK schema/config、响应 ID 和工具投影修复，补齐 source-backed 必需消费者及富内容证据，再做干净候选验收。排查启动期浏览器取消；HTTP/SSE、ACP mounting/subagent 和 B/C/D 继续独立推进，任务不设置 integrated。
